# Generated by tools/codegen/gen_controller.py from controllers/esp32-motor-controller/controller.toml. Do not edit; change the description and regenerate.
# The controller on a PC (Linux, WSL): the same control task, console and tables as the board, with
# the plant behind the HIL link (src/io_hil.c, libs/hil) instead of the on-chip simulation:
#   cmake -S host -B <build> && cmake --build <build>
#   <build>/motor_host --device /dev/pts/N [--lockstep | --hz 1000] [--log] [-c "sp ..."]
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(motor_host C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter) # the board's hooks ignore their ctx

include(../../../libs/cmake/krumpir.cmake)
krumpir_add_libs()
add_subdirectory(../lib/motorctrl motorctrl)

add_executable(motor_host ../src/control_task.c ../src/console.c ../src/gen/ctrl_gen.c
                               ../src/io_hil.c)
target_include_directories(motor_host PRIVATE ../src)
target_compile_definitions(motor_host PRIVATE KRUMPIR_IO_HIL)
target_link_libraries(motor_host PRIVATE motorctrl rte hil_host)

# The controller's closed-loop scenarios on its on-chip plant (tools/scenarios.c), the SIL side
# of tools/hil/compare.py
add_executable(motor_scenarios ../tools/scenarios.c)
target_link_libraries(motor_scenarios PRIVATE motorctrl)

# XCP on UDP (XCPlite, Linux) for the TUI and xcpclient: -DKRUMPIR_XCP=ON, then run with
# --xcp <port> and make the A2L from this ELF (controllers/README.md). Every build has a new EPK.
option(KRUMPIR_XCP "XCP on UDP (XCPlite)" OFF)
if(KRUMPIR_XCP)
  set(XCPLITE_CFG_OVERRIDE ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/xcplib_host_cfg.h)
  add_subdirectory(${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/vendor/XCPlite xcplite EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
  target_compile_options(xcplite PRIVATE -w) # vendored
  add_custom_target(motor_epk BYPRODUCTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xcp_epk.h
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/xcp_epk.h
            -P ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/xcp_epk.cmake)
  add_dependencies(motor_host motor_epk)
  target_sources(motor_host PRIVATE ${KRUMPIR_LIBS_DIR}/osal_host/src/xcp_host.c)
  target_include_directories(motor_host PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
  target_compile_definitions(motor_host PRIVATE KRUMPIR_XCP CTRL_NAME="motor_host")
  target_compile_options(motor_host PRIVATE -g) # the A2L is read from the debug info
  target_link_libraries(motor_host PRIVATE xcplite)
endif()
